scenarios.name: Hero Section Display
scenarios.description: Verify the hero section displays product name, logo, tagline, and call-to-action buttons correctly (REQ-1)

steps.description: Navigate to the homepage URL
steps.context: Page should be accessible and load successfully

steps.description: Check that the animated logo (logo.gif) is displayed in the hero section
steps.context: Logo should be visible and properly sized

steps.description: Confirm the tagline 'A Persistent Key-Value Store with Memcached Protocol' is displayed
steps.context: Tagline should be clearly visible below or near the logo

steps.description: Check that 'Get Started' and 'View on GitHub' buttons are present and functional
steps.context: Both primary and secondary CTAs should be visible and clickable

test_cases.input: Load homepage and inspect hero section
test_cases.expected: Hero section contains product logo (logo.gif) displayed as an image element
Product name 'MirDB' is visible in the hero section
Tagline contains 'Persistent Key-Value Store' and 'Memcached Protocol'
Page scrolls to the quick-start section
Link navigates to GitHub repository URL

scenarios.name: Feature Highlights Section
scenarios.description: Verify the feature highlights section displays key features in a three-column layout (REQ-2)

steps.description: Scroll or navigate to the feature highlights area of the homepage
steps.context: Section should be easily discoverable from hero section

steps.description: Check that three feature cards are displayed: Memcached Compatible, Persistent Storage, High Performance
steps.context: Features should be displayed in a visually appealing card layout

steps.description: Confirm each feature card has a title and description
steps.context: Descriptions should accurately represent product capabilities

test_cases.input: Count feature cards in features section
test_cases.expected: Exactly 3 feature cards are displayed
Feature card with title 'Memcached Compatible' is present with description about existing client compatibility
Feature card with title containing 'Persistent' is present with description about SSTable storage
Feature card with title containing 'Performance' is present with description about LSM tree architecture
Feature cards are arranged in a horizontal three-column layout on desktop viewport

scenarios.name: Quick Start Section
scenarios.description: Verify the quick-start section displays installation and usage instructions with code examples (REQ-3, REQ-4)

steps.description: Scroll or navigate to the quick-start section of the homepage
steps.context: Section should be accessible from Get Started CTA

steps.description: Check that cargo build/run commands are displayed
steps.context: Instructions should be in code block format for easy copying

steps.description: Confirm telnet/client connection example is shown
steps.context: Example should demonstrate basic memcached commands

steps.description: Check that usage.gif demonstration is displayed
steps.context: GIF should illustrate actual product usage

test_cases.expected: Section contains 'cargo' build or run commands in a code block

test_cases.input: Verify code blocks are formatted correctly
test_cases.expected: Code examples are displayed in monospace font with syntax highlighting or code block styling
Usage example includes telnet connection command or similar client connection
Image element with source pointing to usage.gif is present and visible
Usage GIF image has appropriate alt text for accessibility

scenarios.name: GitHub Navigation and Project Status
scenarios.description: Verify navigation to GitHub repository and display of project status badges (REQ-5, REQ-6)

steps.description: Find GitHub repository link on the homepage
steps.context: Link should be prominent in hero section or navigation

steps.description: Confirm the link points to the correct repository URL
steps.context: Should link to github.com/yetone/mirdb

steps.description: Find CI status and version badges
steps.context: Badges should be visible and current

test_cases.expected: At least one link to GitHub repository is present on the page
GitHub link href contains 'github.com' and points to the mirdb repository
CircleCI or similar CI status badge image is displayed

test_cases.input: Verify badge links to CI dashboard
test_cases.expected: Clicking CI badge navigates to CircleCI build status page

scenarios.name: Supported Commands Section
scenarios.description: Verify the supported memcached commands are displayed with examples (REQ-7)

steps.description: Find the section listing supported memcached commands
steps.context: Section should detail protocol compatibility

steps.description: Check that supported commands are listed (get, set, delete, etc.)
steps.context: List should match actual implementation capabilities

steps.description: Confirm examples are provided for key commands
steps.context: Examples should show proper syntax

test_cases.expected: A section dedicated to supported commands exists on the page
The 'get' memcached command is mentioned in the supported commands
The 'set' memcached command is mentioned in the supported commands
Command examples are displayed in code block format

scenarios.name: Footer Section
scenarios.description: Verify the footer contains links to documentation, GitHub, and community resources (REQ-10)

steps.description: Navigate to the bottom of the page to view footer
steps.context: Footer should be visible at page bottom

steps.description: Check that GitHub, Documentation, and License links are present
steps.context: Links should be functional and properly labeled

steps.description: Confirm project attribution and credits are displayed
steps.context: Should include appropriate copyright or license information

test_cases.expected: Page contains a footer element or section at the bottom
Footer contains a link to the GitHub repository
Footer contains a link labeled 'Documentation' or similar
Footer contains a link to license information
Footer contains attribution text or copyright notice

scenarios.name: Page Performance
scenarios.description: Verify the homepage loads within acceptable performance thresholds (NFR-1)

steps.description: Time the full page load from navigation start to load complete
steps.context: Test on standard connection speed

steps.description: Check that images and resources load without errors
steps.context: No 404 errors or broken resources

steps.description: Check that page renders without layout shifts
steps.context: Content should be stable after initial render

test_cases.expected: Page fully loads within 3 seconds on standard connection
All image elements load successfully without 404 errors
No JavaScript console errors on page load
Stylesheets load without errors and styles are applied

scenarios.name: Responsive Design - Mobile
scenarios.description: Verify the homepage is responsive and usable on mobile devices (NFR-2)

steps.description: Resize browser or use device emulation for mobile viewport (375px width)
steps.context: Simulating mobile phone display

steps.description: Check that content reflows appropriately for narrow screen
steps.context: No horizontal scrolling should be required

steps.description: Confirm buttons and links are appropriately sized for touch
steps.context: Minimum 44x44px touch targets recommended

test_cases.expected: Content is readable and no horizontal scroll is required
Feature cards stack vertically on mobile viewport
Navigation elements are accessible and usable on mobile

test_cases.input: Check CTA button sizes on mobile
test_cases.expected: CTA buttons are at least 44px in height for easy tapping

scenarios.name: Responsive Design - Tablet
scenarios.description: Verify the homepage is responsive and usable on tablet devices (NFR-2)

steps.description: Resize browser or use device emulation for tablet viewport (768px width)
steps.context: Simulating tablet display

steps.description: Check that content uses appropriate layout for medium screen
steps.context: May use two-column or adjusted layouts

steps.description: Confirm text and images are appropriately sized
steps.context: Content should be comfortable to read

test_cases.expected: Layout adapts appropriately for tablet viewport
Feature cards display in reasonable layout (2-column or 3-column)
Code examples are readable without horizontal scrolling

scenarios.name: Accessibility - Semantic HTML
scenarios.description: Verify the homepage uses proper semantic HTML structure (NFR-3)

steps.description: Examine the HTML source for semantic elements
steps.context: Should use header, main, footer, section, nav elements

steps.description: Check that headings follow proper h1-h6 hierarchy
steps.context: No skipped heading levels

steps.description: Confirm appropriate ARIA landmarks or HTML5 landmarks
steps.context: Aids screen reader navigation

test_cases.expected: Page contains exactly one h1 element
Headings follow proper hierarchy without skipping levels
Page contains a main element for primary content
Footer content is wrapped in a footer element

scenarios.name: Accessibility - Images
scenarios.description: Verify all images have appropriate alt text for accessibility (NFR-3)

steps.description: Check that logo.gif has descriptive alt text
steps.context: Alt text should describe the image content

steps.description: Check that usage.gif has descriptive alt text
steps.context: Should describe what the GIF demonstrates

steps.description: Verify no images are missing alt attributes
steps.context: Decorative images should have empty alt=''

test_cases.expected: Logo image has non-empty alt attribute describing the logo
Usage GIF has alt text describing the demonstration content

test_cases.input: Verify all img elements have alt
test_cases.expected: Every img element has an alt attribute (empty or descriptive)

test_cases.input: Check badge images for alt text
test_cases.expected: CI status badges have appropriate alt text describing their purpose

scenarios.name: Accessibility - Keyboard Navigation
scenarios.description: Verify the homepage is fully navigable using keyboard only (NFR-3)

steps.description: Navigate through all interactive elements using Tab key
steps.context: All links and buttons should be reachable

steps.description: Check that focused elements have visible focus indicators
steps.context: Users must see which element has focus

steps.description: Verify Enter key activates links and buttons
steps.context: Standard keyboard interaction pattern

test_cases.expected: All links and buttons can be reached via keyboard Tab navigation
CTA buttons show visible focus indicator when focused
Pressing Enter on focused link activates it
Skip to main content link is available for keyboard users

scenarios.name: Accessibility - Color Contrast
scenarios.description: Verify sufficient color contrast ratios throughout the page (NFR-3)

steps.description: Verify body text meets WCAG 2.1 AA contrast requirements (4.5:1)
steps.context: Normal text needs higher contrast than large text

steps.description: Verify headings meet contrast requirements
steps.context: Large text needs at least 3:1 contrast ratio

steps.description: Verify links are distinguishable and meet contrast requirements
steps.context: Links should be identifiable without relying solely on color

test_cases.expected: Body text has at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio against background
CTA button text has at least 4.5:1 contrast ratio
Links are visually distinguishable from surrounding text

scenarios.name: Content Maintainability
scenarios.description: Verify the homepage content is easily maintainable (NFR-4)

steps.description: Examine the HTML/template structure for maintainability
steps.context: Content should be separated from presentation

steps.description: Check that content sections are clearly organized
steps.context: Easy for developers to find and update content

test_cases.expected: HTML uses clear, well-organized structure with comments where appropriate
Content is organized in easily editable sections or separate files
Styles are organized logically and easy to modify

scenarios.name: Privacy - No External Tracking
scenarios.description: Verify the homepage does not include external tracking or analytics that compromise privacy (NFR-5)

steps.description: Monitor network activity on page load
steps.context: Should not make requests to tracking services

steps.description: Check for analytics or tracking scripts in source
steps.context: Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, etc. should not be present

test_cases.expected: No Google Analytics or gtag scripts are included
No Facebook Pixel or similar tracking scripts are included
No requests to known tracking domains on page load
Page does not set third-party tracking cookies

scenarios.name: User Journey - Complete Flow

steps.description: User arrives and immediately sees product purpose

steps.description: Hero section clearly communicates what MirDB is
steps.context: User should understand within 5 seconds

steps.description: User scrolls to see feature highlights
steps.context: Features should build on value proposition

steps.description: User finds getting started instructions
steps.context: Path to implementation should be clear

steps.description: User clicks CTA to GitHub or starts implementation
steps.context: Clear next step available

test_cases.input: Complete user journey from landing to GitHub
test_cases.expected: User can navigate from hero to GitHub link within 3 clicks

test_cases.input: Navigate from hero to quick start
test_cases.expected: Get Started CTA successfully scrolls to quick start section
Installation commands are discoverable within first scroll
Page content follows logical flow: hero -> features -> quick start -> footer
